items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: And we had a drum bass player by the name of Reed Coleman.

ctx.x: Yeah. And he had me on guitar. Mm-hmm. Miss Olivia Charlotte on piano. And Joe Simon on bass. David Bickham on drum. Mm-hmm. That was the band. But for half of those 15 years my son played drums with us. And we had a drum bass player by the name of Reed Coleman. Oh, I see. Yeah. You ever heard of him? Heard of him? He left here and went to New York to live. Oh, is he playing music up there or just... I don't know what Reed Coleman doing.
I don't know what anybody would move to New York for in there. I don't know.
